scope: Source-level UI repetition inventory; no new authenticated full-app/browser verification in this follow-up. Existing audit rendering/browser evidence is named per entry.

findings.actual: Mobile location sheet repeats code/floor in the header and inspector content.
findings.trigger: Select a location in the compact/mobile inspector.
findings.recommendation: Keep one visible identity; preserve the accessible sheet description.
findings.evidence: prior rendered probe and browser fixture; caller source rechecked

findings.actual: Compact inspector repeats the same string as heading and subtitle when zone.label equals zone.code.
findings.recommendation: Show the name only when it differs from the code.

findings.actual: Full location card repeats equal name/code on adjacent lines.
findings.recommendation: Keep one visible identity when the values match.

findings.actual: Expanded position QR list repeats equal position label/code.
findings.recommendation: Guard the secondary name/code line when values match.
findings.evidence: source traced; staging seed sets position.label to code

findings.actual: No stored or reserved units yet appears twice (both locales).
findings.recommendation: Render the empty-inventory sentence once.

findings.actual: Selected location is an extra heading/eyebrow underneath Location details owned by FloorMap.
findings.recommendation: Let the host own the visible panel heading.

findings.actual: Fallback inspector prints equal name/code twice; mobile header adds a third occurrence.
findings.recommendation: Suppress the repeated secondary identity when equal.
findings.evidence: prior desktop/mobile browser screenshots; source rechecked

findings.actual: Non-workspace mobile list repeats equal zone code/label on two lines.
findings.recommendation: Reuse the equality guard already present in FloorWorkspaceLocationList.

findings.actual: Non-workspace desktop grid repeats equal zone code/label.
findings.recommendation: Keep one visible identity when equal.

findings.actual: Catalogue location cell repeats equal label/code.
findings.recommendation: Guard the secondary line when equal.

findings.actual: Registered location row repeats equal code/name side by side.
findings.recommendation: Show the name only when it differs.

findings.actual: Desktop scan record repeats the location code when locationName equals it.
findings.recommendation: Compare the displayed name with the displayed code before rendering.
findings.evidence: source traced; jobScans backend maps zone.label into locationName

findings.actual: Selected scan location header repeats equal code/name.
findings.recommendation: Skip the secondary location name when equal.

findings.actual: Employee code and site appear in both the identity subtitle and detail list.
findings.recommendation: Choose one presentation for code/site; retain the complete site identity.

findings.actual: Organization access required (TH: ต้องมีสิทธิ์องค์กร) is both page and notice title.
findings.recommendation: Retain one visible main heading and the explanatory body.

findings.actual: The same error title is shown in PageHeader and Notice.
findings.recommendation: Use one heading plus recovery explanation and retry action.

findings.actual: Different unmapped recommendation reason codes render identical fallback list items.
findings.trigger: No fitting candidate; multiple unmapped reason codes
findings.recommendation: Map each known reason to its actual cause; deduplicate equivalent messages.
findings.evidence: prior real-helper probe; rendering caller rechecked

findings.actual: Move destination refusal list repeats the same fallback for different reasons.
findings.trigger: No candidate; multiple unmapped reason codes
findings.recommendation: Use the complete shared mapping and deduplicate equivalent messages.
findings.evidence: prior real-helper probe; rendering caller rechecked

findings.actual: Generic retry/correct wording appears alongside a separate stale-session conflict notice.
findings.recommendation: Render one accurate conflict notice and recovery path.
findings.evidence: prior rendered save-conflict probe; source rechecked

findings.actual: Scan icon and full-width Start/Stop camera button control the same camera state.
findings.recommendation: Let one control own the camera state; retain manual verification.
findings.evidence: source traced through BarcodeCameraBox:202/212 and ScanCodeInput

findings.actual: Top scan icon and BarcodeCameraBox Stop camera button both stop the active location scanner.
findings.recommendation: Keep one obvious scanner close/state control.
findings.evidence: source traced through BarcodeCameraBox:202 and cancelScan

findings.actual: Top Sparkles action and child Read with AI button open the same blank AI reader when no image is selected.
findings.trigger: canReadImage, QR mode, no selected image
findings.recommendation: Use one blank AI entry; preserve the distinct read-selected-image/crop action.

findings.actual: Active Barcode mode button and child Stop camera button both close the barcode panel.
findings.recommendation: Use one panel/camera close control.
findings.evidence: source traced through BarcodeCameraBox:206 and onClose

review_before_removing.actual: Two X icons in the desktop inspector.
review_before_removing.meaning: Hide details retains selection; Clear selection removes it. Decide the interaction before consolidating; audit Back semantic targets if changed.

review_before_removing.actual: The unit count appears in the metric, product summary, and inventory disclosure.
review_before_removing.meaning: Related counts are in different contexts; choose compact presentation without removing per-product or inventory meaning.

review_before_removing.actual: Capture, choose image, and use device camera can be shown together.
review_before_removing.meaning: Web camera, gallery, and device camera are distinct capabilities. Clarify hierarchy; retain fallbacks.

review_before_removing.actual: ชั้น / FLOOR repeats the floor concept in two languages.
review_before_removing.meaning: Localization preference; use one language if bilingual labels are not intended.

review_before_removing.actual: Quick Change · แก้ไขด่วน repeats the action in two languages.
review_before_removing.meaning: Terminology preference; confirm the established product-name convention before replacing.

review_before_removing.actual: If label equals code, QR dialog title and code caption repeat the identity.
review_before_removing.meaning: Caption is useful beneath a printed/scanned QR. Consider a generic dialog title rather than dropping its human-readable code.

review_before_removing.actual: Add in the page header and Create finished good in the empty state link to the same form.
review_before_removing.meaning: This is a common useful empty-state pattern; streamline only if it creates clutter.

review_before_removing.actual: Four attendance filters use the same large icon-card anatomy; the shared component adds a 48px decorative block.
review_before_removing.meaning: The icons and filter actions are different. A compact strip is a density choice, not a duplicate-action defect.

excluded_false_positives: mutually exclusive desktop/mobile or editor branches
same icon used for distinct records or workflows
SearchDialog loader/loaded body swap: code duplication, not two simultaneously visible headers
FloorWorkspaceLocationList already hides equal visible name/code at lines 185-186 and 252; non-workspace FloorLocationTable remains a separate caller
